doc.title: Derek Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 5, 2021

title: Established musicians still seeking gigs
summary: Rowe notes even stars like Clark Terry asked for gigs; Brown says that is true in this genre.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: You know some things never change. I recall when we started this project, 25 years ago, that I would be interviewing people like Clark Terry, at that level, and I would be surprised afterwards that some of them would hit me up for a gig. And the reason it surprised me is I just thought, you know being a fan of these guys that by this point in their career they had it made.
